name: Archipelago Multiworld
author: wizzzle.wizzzle@gmail.com
description: Archipelago multi-game randomizer server (ArchipelagoServer / MultiServer). Upload a generated AP_*.zip seed to the seeds/ folder and start.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Archipelago install script (runs in ghcr.io/parkervcp/installers:debian)
set -e
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl jq tar ca-certificates >/dev/null

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${AP_VERSION}" ] || [ "${AP_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    AP_VERSION=$(curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest | jq -r '.tag_name')
fi
echo "Installing Archipelago ${AP_VERSION}"

URL="https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/download/${AP_VERSION}/Archipelago_${AP_VERSION}_linux-x86_64.tar.gz"
curl -fL -o archipelago.tar.gz "${URL}" || { echo "Download failed: ${URL}"; exit 1; }

# Keep the user's host.yaml across reinstalls/updates
[ -f Archipelago/host.yaml ] && cp Archipelago/host.yaml /tmp/host.yaml.bak
tar -xzf archipelago.tar.gz
rm -f archipelago.tar.gz
[ -f /tmp/host.yaml.bak ] && cp /tmp/host.yaml.bak Archipelago/host.yaml
chmod +x Archipelago/ArchipelagoServer || true

mkdir -p seeds Archipelago/custom_worlds

cat > start.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
cd /home/container
SEED_DIR=/home/container/seeds

if [ -n "${SEED_FILE}" ]; then
    SEED="${SEED_DIR}/${SEED_FILE}"
else
    SEED=$(ls -t "${SEED_DIR}"/*.zip "${SEED_DIR}"/*.archipelago 2>/dev/null | head -n1)
fi

if [ -z "${SEED}" ] || [ ! -f "${SEED}" ]; then
    echo "No seed found. Upload your generated AP_*.zip (or .archipelago file) into the 'seeds' folder, then start the server again."
    exit 1
fi
echo "Using seed: ${SEED}"

ARGS=(--host 0.0.0.0 --port "${SERVER_PORT}")
[ -n "${SERVER_PASSWORD}" ] && ARGS+=(--password "${SERVER_PASSWORD}")
[ -n "${ADMIN_PASSWORD}" ]  && ARGS+=(--server_password "${ADMIN_PASSWORD}")
ARGS+=(--hint_cost "${HINT_COST:-10}")
ARGS+=(--location_check_points "${LOCATION_CHECK_POINTS:-1}")
ARGS+=(--release_mode "${RELEASE_MODE:-auto}")
ARGS+=(--collect_mode "${COLLECT_MODE:-auto}")
ARGS+=(--remaining_mode "${REMAINING_MODE:-goal}")
ARGS+=(--auto_shutdown "${AUTO_SHUTDOWN:-0}")

exec ./Archipelago/ArchipelagoServer "${ARGS[@]}" "${SEED}"
EOF
chmod +x start.sh

echo "Install complete. Upload your seed to the seeds/ folder."

variables.name: Archipelago Version
variables.description: Release tag to install (e.g. 0.6.2) or 'latest'. Must match (or be newer than) the version used to generate the seed. Reinstall the server after changing.

variables.name: Seed File
variables.description: File name inside seeds/ to host. Leave empty to use the most recently uploaded seed.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password players need to join. Leave empty for none.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Password for /admin commands from clients. Leave empty to disable remote admin.

variables.name: Hint Cost
variables.description: Percent of total location checks one hint costs (0-100).

variables.name: Location Check Points
variables.description: Hint points earned per location checked.

variables.name: Release Mode
variables.description: When players may !release their remaining items.

variables.name: Collect Mode
variables.description: When players may !collect their items from other worlds.

variables.name: Auto Shutdown
variables.description: Minutes of inactivity before the server shuts down. 0 = never.
